label: 四個已看過答案球季；全季同季重現，不能宣稱盲測或換隊有效
scope: One defensive rebounding replacement only. No offense, rim, live turnover, zone, foul or rotation mechanism changes. Finish and stop.

baselines.T0: Immutable existing pure runs; exact same cards/schedule/seeds/minute soft targets.
baselines.pooled: Pure cards with league-only rebound odds intercept, shooting-logit offset and pace recalibrated independently with the identical algorithm used for the candidate. Separates mean correction from a new defensive card.

inputs: individual DREB count and MIN (official box)
forbidden: team net/wins/ranks as inputs or calibration targets
card.opportunity: N=DREB/DREB_PCT for positive observations; zero-DREB players use pooled sum(N)/sum(MIN) times own MIN. Missing official share falls back to the pooled mean, flagged. All season total individuals, including traded players pooled, not team-filtered.
card.shrinkage: Beta empirical-Bayes method of moments over valid players with at least500 season minutes. mu=sum(DREB)/sum(N), variance=unweighted population variance of individual DREB_PCT; sampling variance=mean(mu*(1-mu)/N); kappa=clip(mu*(1-mu)/max(variance-samplingVariance,1e-6)-1,1,10000). Posterior=(DREB+kappa*mu)/(N+kappa). All computed separately within the supplied season individual data; no outcomes fitted.
card.projection: Sum five posterior DREB shares, clip [.05,.95]. Candidate FG player-OREB logit = logit(old offense versus canonical PG/SG/SF/PF/C neutral defense) - logit(DEFAULT_OREB_SHARE) - logit(sum defensive shares) + leagueOrbLogit. Final FG probability clip [.05,.60], unchanged bounds. Defensive recipient weights .30/5+.70*share/sum. Offensive skills/geometry/recipient weights unchanged. FT team-share and team/out-of-bounds branches unchanged. No change to stamina (old rebound itself is not fatigue-scaled).
card.switch: individualDrebCard; false with leagueOrbLogit=0 must reproduce all 1230 game scores and complete team/player stats for seed20261012 in each season.
card.boxout: Audit only. Hustle BOX_OUT_PLAYER_TEAM_REBS minus BOX_OUT_PLAYER_REBS is already credited to teammate DREB and combines offensive/defensive plays; do not add it again. No identified causal extra recovery probability => no boxout bonus this version. Report coverage and limitation.

calibration.selection: Last evaluated iteration; early stop only all pooled thresholds met. Never select by team accuracy.
calibration.targets: Whole-season merged individual credited OREB/(OREB+DREB), league offensive proxy and paired possession proxy. No team net/rank/wins. Team rebound counts unaltered.
calibration.updates: additional shotDelta += clip((target efficiency - simulated efficiency)/65,-.08,.08); pace *= target possessions/sim possessions, clipped [.5,2]; leagueOrbLogit += clip(logit(target OREB share)-logit(sim OREB share),-.25,.25). FT/foul/TOV parameters frozen. Identical loops for pooled and dreb.
calibration.acceptanceGuard: Report evaluation league efficiency and possession biases against ±0.5, TOV/FG%/3P% drift explicitly; failed calibration is not patched after evaluation.

evaluation.primary: Centered team net RMSE. Secondary centered DREB% RMSE, defensive efficiency RMSE/correlation/SD ratio, net Spearman, SD ratio, calibration slope, wins MAE/RMSE, ranks and T0 failure rules. Report candidate-pooled and candidate-T0 and pooled-T0; do not attribute pooled correction to the card.
evaluation.adoption: Candidate only warrants further mainline work if four-season net RMSE paired joint95 interval is entirely below0 versus pooled, DREB centered RMSE improves (point estimate), and net-rank failure count does not increase. Otherwise retain pure baseline and explicitly mark failure/inconclusive. No changes after seeing results. Statistical success is same-season only; portability still untested.

rankRules.pass: zero net-axis failures. Wins rank reference only; explanation never waives failure

attribution.principle: Observational abnormality alone is not causal attribution. Counterfactual must remove failure on its own axis and reduce absolute error >=50%, with sign agreement. Otherwise unexplained, with anomaly flags reported separately. Never coach/tactics attribution.

clutch.definition: Fourth quarter and overtime clock <=300 seconds, pre-event absolute lead <=5. Score increments and elapsed time use prior-event scoreboard; only exact final-score/event-score reconciliation games accepted.
clutch.impact: (clutch net - nonclutch net/minute * clutch minutes)/all season games; coverage >=85%, incomplete game impact extrapolated by GP/validGP. No simulations adjusted.
clutch.counterfactual: actual net minus impact; rank all 30 again. Only net-axis explanation; wins attribution requires unavailable simulated clutch traces, so never inferred.

luck.expectedWins: GP * PF^14/(PF^14+PA^14), fixed exponent 14 diagnostic convention, not fitted to answers
luck.counterfactual: actual wins replaced by net-based expected wins, rank all 30 again; only wins-axis eligible. This is win conversion anomaly, not proof of random luck and cannot explain net error.

attribution.unresolved: No qualifying explanation => 無法解釋. Partial contributions and flags not promoted to explained.

tanking.name: season-end previous-top5 minute-share marker
tanking.top5: Previous-season total player minutes within franchise, tie playerID. Only existing prior season logs, no new download. 2022-23 prior missing => unavailable.
tanking.windows: First20 vs last20 target-season chronological team games
tanking.ratio: Sum minutes of those five / all current team player minutes; difference final minus initial
tanking.interpretation: Descriptive only. Does not explain or waive failures; observed minutes already contain DNP/absences. Departure also lowers marker, no inference of intent.

uncertainty.scheme: Resample30 franchises and20 seeds, paired across all versions and seasons; average seed predictions before metrics; center each season and pool seasons equally. Only joint95 intervals used for claims.

hypotheses.expected: Independent observed DREB shares may repair suppressed defensive rebound differences and remove double-counted size/position proxies. No numeric gain promised.
hypotheses.failure: Individual DREB is affected by teammates/opponent misses, linear five-share composition may be poorly transferable; old offensive geometry still biases rebound contests; boxout cooperation not identified.
